name: Asian Chicken Salad Wraps with Cucumber, Bell Pepper & Hoisin Sauce
ingredients: 1 (30 oz) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Juice one lime into a large bowl. Cut remaining lime into wedges and set aside for serving.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the lime juice along with hoisin sauce and black pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and halve bell pepper crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl.
Place chicken on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, add to the bowl, and toss to combine the salad.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Divide tortillas between plates, fill with chicken salad, and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve with lime wedges for squeezing and additional hoisin sauce for dipping. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
